reviews.review:
Before v.2.0.0, I wouldn't have recommended this game as it was filled with bugs. Fortunately, the update fixes almost all the bugs I noticed on my first playthrough.
As it stands, it's cute, it's funny and it's heartwarming. I was legitimately kind of moved by the ending. Glad the small dev team took the time to fix the bugs, as this game deserves to be finished.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you so much for this, it really means a lot to me!

I know the game had a rough time before 2.0.0, so hearing that the update improved your experience is incredibly reassuring. I’m constantly fixing bugs and polishing things whenever I can. I’m a solo developer, and while I can’t support myself working on the game full-time yet, I put as much of my free time as possible into making it better.

I’m very happy to hear that the story connected with you and that the ending moved you! That’s honestly the best feedback I could hope for :)

Thanks A LOT for your patience and for sticking with the game. It truly means more than you might think!
–Guigo
